description:
Reusable, fixture-tested tooling produces native and deterministic source candidates from an authenticated immutable event; it emits no v1 candidate.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The producer script/interface accepts only the immutable candidate envelope, performs identity preflight before any build/archive command, builds web before jit-server, and defines the Linux x86_64 musl archive/extracted-binary and server smoke without a public-publish step or release-execution workflow YAML wrapper.
- [hard] REQ-02: A pinned release-tool manifest plus committed .gitattributes export-ignore policy defines a deterministic source archive from git archive --format=tar --prefix=just-in-time-1.0.0/ <FREEZE_SHA>, fixed Git config/umask/locale, and no-timestamp deterministic compression. The documented exclusion list removes repository-internal planning/agent/CI metadata while retaining Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/, required build inputs, licenses, INSTALL.md, and canonical source-install documentation.
- [hard] REQ-03: Source-archive fixture tests reject an untracked/dirty input, wrong tree/SHA, undeclared exclusion, missing install input, non-normalized metadata, or byte variance across two isolated runs. They verify the archive has no .git directory and its recorded tree/file inventory equals the frozen commit after exclusions.
- [hard] REQ-04: Tooling defines SHA-256 manifests, one SPDX JSON artifact/file inventory, and GitHub exact-subject provenance for native archive, source archive, and SBOMs; verifier fixtures reject subject/source/workflow mismatch before candidate acceptance.
- [hard] REQ-05: Extracted-source smoke tooling installs with cargo install --path crates/jit --locked --root <clean-prefix>, runs the canonical source-install procedure from archive bytes with no repository checkout fallback, and verifies jit version/init/quickstart; native smoke retains both binaries plus real embedded web and /api/health.
- [hard] REQ-06: Completion proves only producer scripts/interfaces, export policy, pinned tools and unit fixtures changed; no release-execution workflow YAML, ref/tag, native/source v1 candidate or attestation is created.

## Notes

Blast radius: native/source packaging scripts and interfaces, `.gitattributes`, pinned release-tool manifest, and unit fixtures. Release-execution workflow YAML is outside scope, and candidate execution requires an immutable source freeze.
title: Implement native and source candidate producer tooling
